## 2026-08-15 · the card named a mechanism and the defect was one floor up

Six rounds closed #151, and three of four cards had their own premise fail. Each time the mechanism they asked for already existed — broken was the claim it was meant to carry: uniqueness under a root read as "now", a rule §14 states and nothing returned, a decision defended by an argument we refuted the same day. I saw the shape only at the fourth. Tomorrow's me: before building what a card names, ask what it claims.
